title: Finish Off a Pass in Stride
description: A passer leads a moving teammate toward the rim, and the finisher gathers the pass without breaking stride, the exact skill a fast break depends on.

content.objective: Gather a pass in full stride and finish without breaking the push rhythm.
content.setup: A passer stands at the wing; the finisher pushes toward the rim from the top of the key.
instructions: The finisher pushes toward the rim at a steady pace.
The passer delivers the ball ahead of the finisher's path, not directly at the current position.
The finisher gathers with both hands without slowing the push.
Finish softly off the backboard and collect the rebound.
coachingPoints: Lead the pass to where the finisher is going.
Keep pushing through the catch rather than pausing to receive it.
Protect the ball immediately on the catch.
commonMistakes: Passing directly at the finisher's current spot instead of ahead of it.
Slowing down awkwardly to gather an imprecise pass.
Rushing the last few strokes instead of gathering under control.
content.safety: Keep the finishing lane clear of any other group's drill.
